To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Cell processor architecture is suitable to accelerate the progressive alignment phase in Clustalw, but it is not suitable for the initialization phase.
the Cell processor can be used as a general purpose platform for Bioinformatics applications and that the scalability analysis of a program can provide useful information for its parallelization.
the Cell processor is a good platform for the parallelization of the progressive alignment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
analyzing the performance of ClustalW in order to understand its scalability and identify the bottlenecks.
the analysis of the scalability of a progressive alignment algorithm on the Cell processor.
a careful analysis of the scalability bottlenecks of the progressive alignment algorithm in order to identify the main sources of performance loss and propose solutions to overcome them.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ClustalW scales very well up to a certain input size, and then the scalability is lost.
the scalability of progressive alignment on the Cell processor is limited to a small number of sequences, and it is mainly due to the profile initialization phase.
the scalability of ClustalW depends on the input size, the number of cores and the phase of execution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for large input sizes, the PPE is the bottleneck and, for small input sizes, the SPEs are the bottleneck.
ClustalW is scalable for the Cell architecture.
the Cell architecture is suitable for the progressive alignment of small to medium size datasets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the scalability of a parallel application is highly dependent on the algorithmic phase being analyzed, and on the input data size.
the Cell processor can be effectively used to speed up sequence alignment.
a careful analysis of the algorithm and of the underlying hardware is required to obtain the best performance.
